T_CLIENT_ID datatrans_client_add(P_FUN_GENERAL_APP_CB app_cb)

add data transmission client to gatt stack

Parameters:

app_cb -- [in] application callback function

Returns:

bool datatrans_client_start_discovery(uint8_t conn_id)

start discovery data transmission service

Parameters:

conn_id -- [in] connection link id

Return values:

  • TRUE -- start discovery success

  • FALSE -- start discovery fail

bool datatrans_client_read_by_handle(uint8_t conn_id, datatrans_read_type_t type)

read data from server by using handles.

Parameters:

  • conn_id -- [in] connection link id

  • type -- [in] one of characteristic that has the readable property.

Return values:

  • TRUE -- send request to upper stack success.

  • FALSE -- send request to upper stack failed.

bool datatrans_client_read_by_uuid(uint8_t conn_id, datatrans_read_type_t type)

read data from server by using uuids.

Parameters:

  • conn_id -- [in] connection link id

  • type -- [in] one of characteristic that has the readable property.

Return values:

TRUE -- send request to upper stack success. FALSE: send request to upper stack failed.

bool datatrans_client_data_out_cccd_set(uint8_t conn_id, bool command)

enable or disable the notification of peer server's notify characteristic.

Parameters:

  • conn_id -- [in] connection link id

  • command -- [in] 0-disable the notification, 1-enable the notification.

Return values:

  • TRUE -- send request to upper stack success.

  • FALSE -- send request to upper stack failed.

bool datatrans_client_data_in_write(uint8_t conn_id, uint8_t *pdata, uint16_t length)

send write request to peer server's control point characteristic.

Parameters:

  • conn_id -- [in] connection link id

  • pdata -- [in] data to write

  • length -- [in] data length

Return values:

  • TRUE -- send request to upper stack success.

  • FALSE -- send request to upper stack failed.

bool datatrans_client_handle_set(datatrans_handle_type_t type, uint16_t value)

used by application, to set the handles in datatrans handle cache.

Parameters:

  • value -- [in] handle value to set.

Return values:

  • TRUE -- success.

  • FALSE -- failed.
